name: Board of Directors
statusNote: V1 built 2026-06-25; not yet pushed to a public repo as of the last handoff snapshot.
oneLiner: Six finance-creator brain models convened as a deliberating board for a money question — a spread of named perspectives with surfaced disagreement, never a verdict, never advice.
stack: Single self-contained index.html (no build step, runs from file://)
Persona data inline plus a machine-readable data/advisors.json mirror
Optional local Ollama for the live mode; no API keys

components.name: Board browser
components.desc: Browse the six seats and their persona write-ups.

components.name: Convene form
components.desc: Question + situation + seat selection, assembled into a single council prompt.

components.name: Report loader
components.desc: Feed the board a .md/.txt report via FileReader — works from file://.

components.name: Convene Live
components.desc: Best-effort path to a local Ollama endpoint; graceful fallback to copy-paste into a chat model.

components.name: advisors/ + data/advisors.json
components.desc: Six persona write-ups plus the machine-readable mirror.

components.name: board-reads/
components.desc: Records of convened deliberations, each saved as both Markdown and a formally styled webpage.

dataFlow: The user poses a question and selects seats; the app assembles one council prompt with personas, a return-block format, a Chair protocol, and house rules.
The user copies it into their own chat model (core path) or convenes live against local Ollama (best effort).
Each seat answers in isolation: stance, confidence, reasoning, and what would change its mind.
The Chair collects, runs at most two debate rounds, and synthesizes a confidence-weighted vote split plus the strongest dissent — never a buy/sell.
Report mode: a loaded report with a Questions-for-the-Board section auto-seats those members, who answer grounded in the report's data.
Board reads of trading-session reports are saved as a paired .md and .html record.
integrations: Optional local Ollama (no API key, no cloud calls from the app)
Consumes Sentinel session reports by document-format convention only — no code dependency
decisions: Persona docs plus a convene protocol on one strong LLM, not a multi-model roundtable — multi-model infra rejected as unnecessary V1 cost.
Responsible framing is product behavior, not a disclaimer footer: mandatory dissent, neutral framing, named-lens attribution, no buy/sell ever.
Persona faithfulness over the brief's assumptions — two personas were deliberately corrected rather than modeled inaccurately.
Board reads are always recorded as both Markdown and a formal light-themed webpage, since they go to other people.
No PDF parsing in V1 — kept dependency-free.
